prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Hospital medication dispensing/returns. Aliases: Cinderwake=Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot; Juniper=Pharmacy Verification Station; Tallowmere=Medication Return Kiosk; Larkspur=Registered Nurse; Morrowglass=Medication Order Gateway; Bluejay=Sensor-monitored Medication Cooler; Copperfield=Pharmacy Technician; Stonewake=Biomedical Engineer. Morrowglass validates/routes/statuses orders, produces Order Reconciliation Snapshot; rejects incomplete/inconsistent updates, retains reasons. Discrepancies block preparation. Clinical Pharmacist produces Dose Exception Review Slip; assesses dose/route/timing/patient concerns. Exceptions=mismatch/omission/duplicate/clinical implausibility before release; hold until authorized documented disposition. Corrections require valid authorized orders, never dispensing-history inference. Cinderwake stops affected picks, securely holds packages, preserves scans/quantities; prepares authorized orders, records handling, produces Priority Refill Tote Tag. Juniper compares order/product/strength/quantity, blocks differences/unauthorized/incomplete release; records exception category/evidence/disposition/reviewer using slip; produces Batch Release Note; retains identifiers/time/credentials. Copperfield prepares/rechecks/evidence-gathers, never decides clinical doses; produces Cold Chain Handoff Card. Bluejay timestamps/displays temperatures/excursions/connectivity loss; affected stock unavailable pending assessment; custody-transfer cold-chain maintained. Manifest/records precede delivery. Hospital Courier accepts suitable loads, produces Pneumatic Capsule Seal Record, handles automation-unsuitable loads; collects only closed, recorded-ready bins. Pneumatic Tube Network requires compliance/identifier/destination reconciliation. East Tube Dispatch Console checks availability/routes/status, sends Tube Route Exception Ticket; West Tube Dispatch Console authorizes routing. Faults require holds/documented resolution; Operations coordinates accountable alternatives; restart requires tests/checks/authorization. Receiving department/ward staff verify destination/packaging/identifiers/quantity; isolate discrepancies, prohibit unresolved stocking, stage accepted loads for placement authorization. North Ward Cabinet Controller uses tote tag, blocks held access; South Ward Cabinet Controller reports lock/access failures immediately; both record arrivals, block Out of Service dispensing until Ready for Dispense/checks. Charge Nurse sends Cabinet Downtime Notice before restoration; assigns unresolved receipts/returns/exceptions through handover. Stonewake/IT Operations Specialist document repairs. Larkspur locks transactions, confirms nonadministration, escalates urgency; never bypasses/substitutes. Returns: reconcile/segregate/secure; Tallowmere produces Return Bin Audit Label for Copperfield. Medication

New part:
S140: The Medication Safety Officer reviews suspected diversion, repeated high-risk exceptions, and events with potential for patient harm.
S141: IT Operations Specialist receives the Diversion Review Packet and checks access, transaction, and device logs without changing the clinical disposition.
S142: The Biomedical Engineer evaluates a suspected mechanical or sensor fault and advises whether the affected equipment can safely return to service.
S143: The IT Operations Specialist investigates software or connectivity faults and records the technical findings for the responsible operational team.
S144: A serious or time-critical exception is escalated immediately by the observing staff member rather than held for routine review.
S145: If the clinical review remains inconclusive, the transaction stays on hold and the Clinical Pharmacist seeks a higher-level clinical decision.
S146: The final disposition records who reviewed the exception, what evidence supported the decision, and whether the medication was released, corrected, or withheld.
S147: Morrowglass validates each medication order for patient, product, dose, route, and timing fields before making it available for downstream processing.
S148: Copperfield confirms that the reconciliation queue has no unresolved discrepancy before authorizing routine cabinet replenishment.
S149: Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot uses the Order Reconciliation Snapshot to compare requested quantities with completed dispense events and current cabinet balances.
S150: Reconciliation compares the active order record with dispensing and cabinet records using a stable order identifier.
S151: The comparison preserves the order context needed to distinguish a new request from a correction or a repeat submission.
S152: Pharmacy Fulfillment Robot retains the patient, medication, dose, route, and timing details associated with each order while preparing a dispense transaction.
S153: It also checks whether the order is active and whether its authorization remains valid at the time of processing.
S154: A cancelled order is excluded from routine preparation even when a matching dispense request remains in a local queue.
S155: A corrected order is treated as a new authoritative version, and superseded values are not carried forward.
S156: Duplicate submissions are flagged for review rather than converted into additional cabinet quantity.
S157: Partial dispensing is reconciled against the quantity already recorded so that remaining quantity is calculated conservatively.
S158: Time stamps and transaction identifiers are retained to support comparison across records that arrive at different times.
S159: When the records disagree on patient, medication, or quantity, the affected transaction remains on hold until the discrepancy is resolved.
S160: The reconciliation outcome records the matched values, unresolved differences, and disposition for subsequent audit.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
